# CohnReznick

> CohnReznick is a leading professional services firm providing integrated audit, assurance, tax, and advisory services across diverse industries including financial services, healthcare, consumer and industrial sectors.

CohnReznick serves mid-market and enterprise clients with specialized expertise in regulated industries such as hedge funds, broker-dealers, REITs, healthcare providers, and cannabis businesses. The firm combines traditional accounting and audit services with modern advisory capabilities including supply chain optimization, ERP implementation, and healthcare transformation.

## Key Topics

- Audit & Assurance
- Tax Advisory & Planning
- Financial Services
- Healthcare
- Consumer & Industrial

- PCAOB Compliance

- Cannabis Compliance

## Financial Services Industry

- [Financial Services](https://www.cohnreznick.com/industries/financial-services): Financial services including broker-dealers, hedge funds & REITs
- [Hedge Fund Services](https://www.cohnreznick.com/industries/financial-services/hedge-funds): Hedge fund audit, tax, advisory & offshore compliance services
- [Broker-Dealer Services](https://www.cohnreznick.com/industries/financial-services/broker-dealers): Broker-dealer audits, PCAOB compliance & regulatory filings
- [Real Estate Investment Trusts](https://www.cohnreznick.com/industries/financial-services/real-estate-investment-trusts): REIT audit, tax advisory & cost segregation services

## Healthcare Industry

- [Healthcare Services](https://www.cohnreznick.com/industries/healthcare): Healthcare advisory for hospitals, senior living & compliance
- [Healthcare Performance Transformation](https://www.cohnreznick.com/industries/healthcare/healthcare-performance-transformation): Healthcare transformation with revenue cycle & supply chain focus
- [Community Health Services](https://www.cohnreznick.com/industries/healthcare/community-health): Community health cost reporting, FQHC & pharmacy 340B services

## Consumer & Industrial Industry

- [Consumer & Industrial Services](https://www.cohnreznick.com/industries/consumer-and-industrial): Consumer, industrial, hospitality & manufacturing services
- [Cannabis Industry Services](https://www.cohnreznick.com/industries/consumer-and-industrial/cannabis): Cannabis accounting, tax & compliance for plant-touching firms
- [Consumer & E-Commerce Services](https://www.cohnreznick.com/industries/consumer-and-industrial/consumer): E-commerce & retail accounting with ASC 842 lease expertise
